subject: Next steps & proposed engagement roadmap for HealthLens
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@healthlens.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthlens.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & proposed engagement roadmap for HealthLens

Hi Samira / Tom —

Great speaking with both of you earlier. Per our discovery call, I captured the core outcomes and put together an initial engagement roadmap (attached) with two timeline options and milestone owners so we can align on scope and target close. Highlights from the call:

- Primary use case: patient triage summarization and EMR enrichment (low-latency, HIPAA-sensitive).
- Key constraints: must pass security review, require SOC 2 evidence for PII handling, decision maker is VP Engineering (Tom) and procurement lead (Samira).
- Success criteria: sub-200ms 95th percentile for inference on representative payloads, and weekly cost target under $X/token (we'll quantify during pilot).

Attached: RI_Engagement_Roadmap_v1.xlsx (initial draft) and HealthLens_TACs_Annex.pdf (security checklist summary).

Two proposed timeline options — pick the one that best fits your internal calendar:

1) Option A — Accelerated pilot (4 weeks):
   - Week 0: Kickoff + environment access / Data sharing scoping
   - Week 1–2: Integration + performance tuning on a sampled dataset
   - Week 3: Validation + UAT with 5 pilot users
   - Week 4: Pilot close + recommendations + PO/commit discussion
   - Target close (if committed): 2026-07-30
   - Primary responsibilities: HealthLens — provide sample payloads & security contacts; Redwood — deliver deployment on dedicated instance, run perf bench.

2) Option B — Standard pilot (8 weeks):
   - Weeks 0–2: Kickoff + security intake + environment prep
   - Weeks 3–5: Iterative integration + model tuning + caching strategy
   - Weeks 6–7: UAT + quality evaluation and regression tests
   - Week 8: Pilot close + proposal + procurement handoff
   - Target close: 2026-09-01
   - This option gives extra time for procurement and security reviews.

Dependencies / blockers we flagged:
- Security review (HealthLens InfoSec): need contact and estimated SLA for assessment.
- Procurement: PO timeline and standard T&Cs (I attached the TAC annex we typically use).
- Data access: sample payloads redacted for PHI or a limited test dataset.

Ask: Can you confirm two things by end of this week?
1) Which timeline (Option A / B) you prefer.
2) The names/emails of the internal stakeholders who should be on the MAP (technical owners, procurement, InfoSec).

If Option A is possible, I can tentatively block vendor resources next week. If Option B is better, we’ll add a security intake buffer and update milestone dates. I also propose a 30-minute kickoff once stakeholders are confirmed — suggested windows: Wed 6/24 10–11am PT or Thu 6/25 2–3pm PT.

Thanks again — happy to adjust the roadmap based on your inputs.

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123


-----Original Message-----
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@healthlens.io>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthlens.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & proposed engagement roadmap for HealthLens

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the clear options. After a quick sync with Tom and our security lead, we prefer Option B (Standard pilot). A few notes:

- Security: loop in Priya Mathur (p.mathur@healthlens.io) — she will run the intake and needs the TAC annex you attached.
- Procurement: I’ll aim to get an estimated PO timeline back to you by 7/9; we may need 2–3 weeks after pilot close for internal approvals.
- Stakeholders: Confirming
     • Tom Reynolds — VP Engineering (tom.reynolds@healthlens.io)
     • Priya Mathur — Head of Security (p.mathur@healthlens.io)
     • Me — Procurement lead (samira.k@healthlens.io)

We’re interested in the Standard timeline to give Priya time for intake. Wed/Thu windows are fine — Thu 6/25 2–3pm PT works best for Tom.

Also, can you add a short milestone for compliance sign-off (signing off on redaction/PHI plan)? That will be required before UAT.

Appreciate it,
Samira
Head of Clinical Ops | HealthLens
samira.k@healthlens.io


On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 18:20 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:

Samira — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming stakeholders and timeline. I’ll update the roadmap to reflect Option B and add an explicit compliance sign-off milestone before UAT.

I’m looping in Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate the kickoff logistics and Monica (Legal/Commercial) for procurement/T&Cs. Marissa — can you take the lead on scheduling the kickoff for Thu 6/25 2–3pm PT and send a brief agenda? Monica — I’ll share the current TAC annex and we may need a short review if HealthLens has redline requests.

Next actions (owners):
- Ben: Update RI_Engagement_Roadmap_v1.xlsx with Option B dates + compliance milestone (today).
- Marissa Cole: Send kickoff invite + Kickoff_Agenda_v1.docx (by EOD).
- Monica Patel: Standby for procurement/T&C questions; I’ll share HealthLens TAC annex.
- HealthLens (Samira/Priya/Tom): Confirm any additional stakeholders and provide a target PO timeline post-pilot.

I’ll reattach the two files and include a HubSpot deal link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-2026-0921

Best,
Ben
